objective: Measure whether the exact locally promoted 10 and 26 August 2026 Landsat-9 Level-2 pair can support a truthful EPSG:32645, owner-local ArcGIS Pro visual before/after panel over the approved source and upper-corridor AOIs, with explicit masks and no change or attribution claim.

exact_scope.archive_reads: Only the two already-promoted exact TARs, after rehashing their frozen size and SHA-256; no network, source substitution, or archive retry.
exact_scope.real_attempt_budget: One new fixed-order header/pixel-QA attempt for each exact product, then at most one conditional ArcGIS visual-panel attempt; stop on first integrity or method failure, no automatic retry.

predeclared_header_gate: Hash each promoted TAR and compare the frozen size and SHA-256 before extracting only the ten exact required members into unique non-Git, append-only attempt paths. Check each extracted member against its container-verification member SHA-256 and never overwrite a source or prior attempt.

Read only MTL and raster headers first. Require matching exact product/scene identity, valid nonempty required files, all eight TIFFs per product on one unrotated 30 m EPSG:32645 grid with integer dimensions and coherent nodata; stop before pixel reads on discrepancy.

Require the two acquired scene grids to share a 30 m lattice: integer-column origin offset within 0.000001 pixel, zero rotation, common positive intersection, and no reprojection or interpolation for grid alignment. The catalog's 40-column offset is a hypothesis to test, not a substitute for acquired-header evidence.
Require USGS Collection-2 Level-2 scale 0.0000275 and offset -0.2 for each B3 through B7 reflectance band from the exact metadata, or stop. Never treat raw DN as reflectance.

predeclared_pixel_qa_method.aoi_area_accounting: Rasterize each approved EPSG:32645 polygon onto the common 30 m lattice with exact cell-polygon intersection-area weights for boundary cells. Total approved AOI area is the denominator for coverage, single-date strict usability, and paired strict usability; report raw intersected area and reconcile to polygon area within the existing 0.02 tolerance.
strict_mask_exclusions: QA_PIXEL fill, dilated cloud, high-confidence cirrus, high-confidence cloud, high-confidence cloud shadow, high-confidence snow/ice, medium-or-high cloud confidence, or reserved/unknown confidence encoding; the Clear bit alone never admits a pixel.
QA_RADSAT saturation in any B3 through B7 displayed or retained QA band, or terrain occlusion.

SR_QA_AEROSOL fill or the conjunction of invalid aerosol retrieval and high aerosol level. Count invalid retrieval, interpolated aerosol, high aerosol, and water separately as visible uncertainty strata; interpolation or invalid retrieval alone is not an automatic exclusion because these occur as part of the documented LaSRC gap-filling procedure.
Per-band zero/nodata, nonfinite values, or calibrated reflectance outside [0, 1] for any B3 through B7. Do not clamp nonphysical values into a display-valid class.
predeclared_pixel_qa_method.reason_accounting: Persist raw overlapping flag counts and one mutually exclusive first-failure reason per AOI cell in fixed order: outside footprint; fill/nodata; cloud/cirrus/shadow; snow/ice; saturation/terrain occlusion; aerosol uncertainty; nonphysical band; strict valid. Report before, after, and same-cell paired masks and the fraction of the full approved AOI for every reason.
predeclared_pixel_qa_method.qualification: An AOI may receive a local visual panel only if both scene footprints cover at least 0.99 of its area and paired strict-valid area is at least 0.20 of its total area. At 0.20 to below 0.80, label that AOI PARTIAL / INSUFFICIENT FOR FULL-AREA COMPARISON. At or above 0.80 with both single-date fractions at or above 0.80, label PIXEL-QA PASS FOR VISUAL COMPARISON ONLY. If neither AOI qualifies, retain QA receipts and produce no before/after panel. No threshold may be lowered after observation.
predeclared_pixel_qa_method.registration_boundary: Shared projected lattice is not measured residual registration. The visual panel makes no pixelwise difference, overlay-change, stable-control, baseline-admission, or co-registration pass claim; those require a separate reviewed method with the existing minimum 30 control pairs and 0.5-pixel RMSE and absolute-bias pass bounds.

conditional_local_arcgis_panel.display_method: For each qualifying AOI, use B7/B6/B4 in RGB. Compute one deterministic nearest-rank 2nd/98th percentile stretch per channel from the pooled before-and-after strict paired-valid pixels of qualifying AOIs, then apply those same channel limits to both dates. Preserve excluded snow/ice and other masks as distinct visible classes; do not tune the stretch by eye or by date.
required_labels: Exact product IDs and UTC acquisition times
AOI-specific footprint, single-date, and paired strict-valid fractions
Mask legend including cloud, shadow, snow/ice, aerosol and nodata
Visual comparison only; residual registration not measured; no change or attribution claim
conditional_local_arcgis_panel.local_outputs: Non-Git, no-replace ArcGIS Pro APRX with georeferenced source rasters and exclusion layers, plus PNG and PDF exports. Reopen APRX in a fresh ArcGIS Pro process, check broken paths and layer sources, and visually inspect both exports. Do not publish derived pixels or call this the final M6 package.

conditional_authority_envelope: Record one owner decision, publish this source-safe packet, implement a versioned exact-source pipeline, and require portable synthetic, installed ArcGIS-runtime synthetic, project-validation, and public-CI gates before any real TIFF header or pixel read.

Run one final no-content preflight of packet hashes, the closed container-intake receipts and both promoted archive hashes, exact AOIs, installed runtime, non-Git free space and no-replace attempt paths. Stop on drift.

Perform one fixed-order real header and pixel-QA evaluation of the before then after source, with append-only receipts and no automatic retry. Stop at the first integrity or method failure; retain unsuccessful outputs and exact limitations.

If and only if at least one AOI qualifies under the frozen visual-only thresholds, perform at most one local ArcGIS Pro panel creation, fresh-process reopen, PNG/PDF export and visual QA. Publish only sanitized metadata, QA aggregates, hashes, status and terminal reconciliation after public CI.
explicit_exclusions: No download, provider request, credentials, terms or account action, alternate scene, archive replacement, reuse of a consumed attempt, or automatic retry.
No threshold, AOI, mask, band order, stretch, datum, grid or source substitution after observing real pixels.

No quantitative difference raster, NDVI/NBR/MNDWI change, baseline admission, geomorphic interpretation, event attribution, public derived-pixel upload, final M6 delivery claim, emergency guidance or scientific publication.
decision_requested: Approve, revise, or defer one conditional pixel-QA and local ArcGIS visual-panel envelope through sanitized terminal publication, with no intermediate owner reconfirmation while the exact gates remain unchanged.
